title: Lovely Peppery Venezuelan Meat Wrap
description: A halal-friendly Venezuelan dish featuring garam masala and wrapped in a ti-leaf, this peppery meat wrap is a cozy and shaggy delight. It is made with marinated meat and spices.
instructions: Preheat a grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Marinate the ground beef with garam masala, black pepper, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the marinated ground beef until it reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Chop the cooked ground beef into small pieces and set aside.
Saute the chopped onion in olive oil until it is translucent.
Add the cooked ground beef to the sauteed onion and stir well.
Add lime juice to the beef and onion mixture and stir again.
Prepare the ti leaves by washing and drying them.
Place about 1/2 cup of the beef and onion mixture onto the center of a ti leaf.
Fold the ti leaf over the filling to form a wrap, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
